text: Travel experiences can be exciting and challenging. When planning a trip, it is important to decide where to go, what to see, and how much to spend. Visiting new countries helps you learn about different cultures and traditions. Trying local food is one of the best parts of travelling, because it lets you taste something completely new. However, language barriers can sometimes make things difficult, especially when you need to ask for directions or order food. Despite these problems, travel creates unforgettable memories that stay with you forever. Every journey teaches you something about the world and about yourself.
